LanguageData.LP_AlchemyTable.label: alchemy table
LanguageData.LP_AlchemyTable.description: A workbench covered with flasks, alembics and mortars. Brew DND potions, storm orbs, gel dressings and psionic suppressants here, and temper cold iron; magic items are now made at the enchanting table, holy relics at the altar, and scrolls and manuals at the scroll desk. Recipe speed is based on the average level of Intellectual and Medicine. Can link a distillery (+15%) and tool cabinets.
